rules.quoted_span: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026 is 3%
rules.conflict_note: The 3% period on this page ended 2026-06-30, before the 2026-10-01 as-of date, and the page shows no rate for 2026-07-01 onward; effective_date 2026-02-02 is the date of the latest formula change on this page (utility add-on removed), not the date of the 3% rate (2025-07-01).

all.unavailable: condominium or townhome tenancy commenced after 1995-12-31

rules.title: Los Angeles RSO annual allowable rent increase (rate page)
rules.requirement: The RSO annual allowable increase shown for July 1, 2025 to June 30, 2026 is 3%; no extra percentage for utilities since Feb 2, 2026. State law requires 30 days' written notice for increases under 10%.

notes: LAHD calculator page; supplies the rate number for the RSO cap (underlying rule is in D041). Stale-rate caveat recorded in conflict_note. Also lists RSO surcharge $1.61 and SCEP surcharge $2.83 per month (not a rule in the six categories).
